implementation.name: Mr. Do! (Replay)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): closed -- FPGAArcade publishes no HDL for this core. The only public artefact is the prebuilt bitstream FPGAArcade/r1_replay_release/mrdo/mrdo.bit plus its .ini video profiles; the organisation's 17 GitHub repositories are firmware, build infrastructure and Amiga support code, with no core sources among them, and that repository's own README says stable builds of migrated cores live off GitHub at build.fpgaarcade.com/releases/. hdl_language_id and license_id are therefore omitted and that absence is the releases-only signal; there is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9). A closed core is still a core that exists for this hardware. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- the Replay distribution has no MRA files. This core is Universal Mr. Do!; the release directory is named mrdo and its notes.txt describes the Mr. Do hardware's rotated framebuffer, so machine_id mrdo, checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: no source and no LICENSE file accompany the bitstream. accuracy_id omitted: notes.txt describes video modes only and makes no timing-fidelity claim.
